records.sourceAnchor: Ministry PLI page last updated 7 September 2026; PLI 1.0 and 1.1 selected-company/MoU status; PLI 1.2 launched 4 November 2025 with 22 product sub-categories
observations: The Ministry page describes the Specialty Steel PLI as a performance-linked manufacturing framework for eligible Indian steel manufacturers, with the original approved outlay of INR 6,322 crore and product categories intended to promote domestic specialty-steel production.

The current official material states that two earlier application rounds were concluded with selected companies and signed project-wise MoUs; the scheme page does not establish a universal new-applicant window for every steel business.

The 2025-26 annual report describes PLI 1.2 as launched on 4 November 2025, covering 22 product sub-categories, with incentive rates of 4% to 15% for five years beginning FY 2025-26 and disbursal beginning FY 2026-27, subject to the applicable documents.

Incentives are tied to approved investment, production, sales and other commitments and are evaluated through claims and verification; scheme outlay, selected-company commitments, capacity and employment figures are not the applicant's benefit ceiling.

The current record is closed for new discovery until a current official invitation is evidenced, while selected-company claim and reporting obligations may continue. Product mapping, investment and production thresholds, base year, MoU, quality, environmental, labour, tax, audit and clawback conditions remain round-specific.
